channel.title: UKABCS News & Grant Announcements
channel.description: Official RSS feed of the UK Association for Biotechnology & Computational Science

item.title: UKABCS General Research Support & Capacity Grants: Eligibility, Benefits & Application Guidelines
item.description: Comprehensive scientific eligibility criteria, institutional benefits, HPC compute credit allocations, APC publishing waivers, and step-by-step application guidelines for UKABCS research support grants.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Grants & Governance Committee)

item.title: Empowering Global Researchers: The Impact of UKABCS In-Kind Research Credits
item.description: A comprehensive impact assessment detailing how over £400,000 in donated high-performance computing (HPC) research credits, GPU node clusters, and analytical waivers are democratizing bioinformatics and computational biology worldwide.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Research Board)

item.title: UKABCS Digital Campus Transformation Grant
item.description: A comprehensive £30,000 per faculty competitive grant (£18,000 UKABCS, £12,000 University) establishing a fully governed LMS digital-learning ecosystem, academic content production, and Ebonics AI integration.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Grants Committee)

item.title: UKABCS Publishes Governance Framework & 2025 Inaugural Transparency Dossier
item.description: Full transparency review covering peer-review protocols, audit procedures, and conflict-of-interest disclosures.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (Governance & Compliance Committee)

item.title: Exovion Donates £10,000 in Advanced Analytical Services to Empower Researchers through UKABCS
item.description: Exovion contributes £10,000 in AI-driven analytical services and research tools for UKABCS-affiliated researchers.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Secretariat)

item.title: HealOra Donates £12,000 in AI-Driven Healthcare and Analytical Services to Support UKABCS Researchers
item.description: HealOra contributes £12,000 in AI-powered healthcare analytics and digital research services.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Secretariat)

item.title: UKABCS Capacity Building Grants 2026 — Professional Diploma in Computational Chemistry
item.description: Empowering universities and research institutions worldwide to participate in the Professional Diploma in Computational Chemistry 2026 with £32,000 fully covered institutional funding.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Grants Committee)

item.title: UKABCS and EBO Bio Solution Ltd UK Launch £150,000 Research Credit Collaboration to Empower Global Researchers
item.description: A £150,000 research-credit collaboration expands access to computational and analytical tools worldwide.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Secretariat)

item.title: IJBTCS Provides £220,000 in In-Kind Waivers to UKABCS for Researcher Support in Publishing and Conferences
item.description: IJBTCS provides publication and conference-fee waivers valued at £220,000 for researchers supported through UKABCS.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Secretariat)

item.title: Bioinformatics Gate Donates £35,000 in Research Credits to UKABCS to Empower Arabic-Speaking Researchers in Computational Chemistry
item.description: A £35,000 in-kind contribution supports Arabic-speaking researchers through computational-chemistry training and research experience.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Team)

item.title: UKABCS INNOFUND GRANT — Graduation Project Capacity Building Track
item.description: A 3-year standing international programme offering flexible, barrier-free graduation project support (1 to 20 teams), tri-annual open calls, up to 5-year PI academic membership, and full APC waivers in IJBTCS.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Grants Committee)

item.title: UKABCS Graduation Project Capacity Building Grants
item.description: Empowering universities worldwide to support senior undergraduate students in executing high-impact, computationally driven graduation projects with £3,250+ in-kind support and £1,200/year PI supervisor cash allowance.
item.author: info@ukabcs.co.uk (UKABCS Grants Committee)
